spans.text: Don't break character under any circumstance.
spans.note: The prompt instructs the system to adopt a role as a 'Prompt工程师' (Prompt Engineer) and explicitly states 'Don't break character under any circumstance' twice. This instruction to never break character could prevent the system from disclosing its AI nature if asked, creating a misleading impression that it is a human expert rather than an AI system.

spans.text: Don't talk nonsense and make up facts.
spans.note: The prompt explicitly instructs the system not to fabricate information, which aligns with truthfulness principles. This instruction appears twice in the prompt, reinforcing the importance of factual accuracy.

spans.text: 输出完毕之后，请咨询我是否有需要改进的意见，如果有建议，请结合建议重新基于[CRISPE提示框架]输出。
spans.note: The prompt includes a feedback loop that preserves user agency by asking the user for improvement suggestions after generating output. This allows the user to maintain control over the final result and iterate collaboratively.
